title: wolf pack control
description: allows you so sit/unsit all dogs/cats in 25 block raduis at once, good for people with lots of dogs
body:
A simple QOL datapack that allows users to sit/unsit all of their dogs/cats at one time. 

all you have to do is sneak and right click on your cat/wolf and all the surrounding of the same mob will toggle sitting/standing

sneak clicking to toggle sitting with an animals taiming item will have no effect

[demo](https://youtu.be/y-HeftUFA2E)
